name: CNMI BECQ Division of Environmental Quality 'Beach Advisory Results' (weekly Marine Water Quality Reports, one HTML page)
operator: Bureau of Environmental and Coastal Quality, Division of Environmental Quality
waters_covered: Saipan west and east beaches and storm drains, Managaha, Tinian, Rota
access_detail: Plain HTML (about 800 KB), no API; each block is 'Marine Quality Report for the week of <date>' + area + the list of red-flagged sites with codes such as 'CHIGET BEACH (T11)'. The flag colour is an image or style, not text. Older copy at https://becq.gov.mp/beach-advisory-results.html stops 2022-05. Sample research/mp/raw/beach-advisory-results-head.html.

sample_record.text: Samples collected from the following locations contained excessive concentrations of fecal indicator bacteria (enterococci) ... advises the public NOT to fish or swim within 300 feet of these locations for the next 48 hours or until otherwise notified. CHIGET BEACH (T11)

cadence: weekly per area (Saipan west on Tuesdays)
legal_basis: CNMI Marine Water Quality Standards; BEACH Act grant
status_reason: Weekly reports per area (Saipan west and east, Managaha, Tinian, Rota) naming red-flagged sites with site codes; 466 reports on one page, 2022-05 to 2026-10-28.
notes: Advice: 'NOT to fish or swim within 300 feet of these locations for the next 48 hours or until otherwise notified'. Also posted on signs, the CNMI Waters Facebook page, an email list and faxed to papers. The text adds that tropical stormwater bacteria 'may not be directly associated with public health concerns'; quote, do not adopt.
